projects.name: Hali Pali Agro Products
projects.description: Hali Pali Agro Products is a traditional, family-run honey business from rural Haryana, based in Village Sandwa, Bhiwani. The website provides a modern digital storefront while retaining the business's authentic, farm-direct identity.

organization.name: Hali Pali Agro Products
organization.description: A traditional, family-run honey business from rural Haryana with a farm-direct identity.

projects.challenge: A traditional, family-run honey business from rural Haryana needed a digital presence that could compete with polished national honey brands without losing its authentic, farm-direct identity.
projects.solution: A full front-end e-commerce experience that turns raw agricultural trust into a modern shopping journey — built entirely from scratch with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and hosted on GitHub Pages.

features.title: Multi-page storefront
features.description: Dedicated Shop, Product listing, and Order Tracking pages rather than only a single landing page.

features.title: Real product architecture
features.description: Sheesham Honey across 3 sizes: 400g — ₹220, 600g — ₹320, 1kg — ₹500. Products include star ratings and dual CTAs: Add to Cart and Buy Now.

features.title: Trust-driven storytelling
features.description: Dedicated sections for sourcing, purity claims, and nutritional benefits including antioxidants and natural energy.

features.title: Social proof system
features.description: Customer testimonial cards containing photos, names, and star ratings.

features.title: Conversion mechanics
features.description: First-order 20% discount banner, email newsletter capture, and a full contact form with business address and phone information.

features.title: Visual storytelling gallery
features.description: Honey Harvest Gallery showcasing farm, bees, honeycomb, and packaging imagery to build authenticity.

features.title: Responsive design
features.description: Fully responsive design optimized for mobile-first Indian shoppers.

screenshots.caption: Homepage

technicalHighlights.title: Google Apps Script Order Integration
technicalHighlights.description: Google Apps Script was used for the Hali Pali order integration with Google Sheets.

technicalHighlights.title: Static Front-End Architecture
technicalHighlights.description: The website was built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without using frameworks such as React, Bootstrap, or Tailwind.

projects.name: Himrohi Expedition
projects.description: Himrohi Expedition is an adventure travel organization focused on school and youth expeditions in the Himalayas. The website is designed around institutional trust and safety rather than typical adventure-tourism marketing.

organization.name: Himrohi Expedition
organization.description: An adventure travel organization focused on school and youth expeditions in the Himalayas.

projects.challenge: Most trekking/adventure sites sell excitement. Himrohi needed to sell something harder: confidence — convincing school administrators and parents to send students into the Himalayas, where safety, not scenery, closes the deal.
projects.solution: A 7-page modular website engineered around institutional trust signals instead of typical adventure marketing hype — reframing the trekking company as a youth safety-focused education partner.

features.title: Full site architecture
features.description: A 7-page website consisting of Home, About Us, Activities, Destinations, Safety Standards, Our Team, and Contact. Destinations has its own subsection.

features.title: Data-led hero section
features.description: The hero section leads with concrete numbers instead of adjectives: 400+ student expeditions delivered, 100% certified instructors, 1:2 guide-to-student safety ratio, and 4 Himalayan regions covered.

features.title: Structured tour catalog
features.description: Programs are presented with altitude, duration, difficulty, and season for quick comparison. Featured routes include Manali Winter Trek, Nubra Valley Ladakh, and Sonamarg Camping Base.

features.title: Dedicated Safety Standards page
features.description: The website includes a dedicated Safety Standards page covering NIM & HMI-certified guides, wilderness first responder training, published safety checklists, and daily briefing protocols.

features.title: Institutional trust grid
features.description: Transparent logistics, 24/7 mountain operations support, and clear operational standards are explicitly presented for risk-averse buyers.

features.title: B2B-style lead generation
features.description: The primary CTA is Request School Catalog using a direct mailto flow rather than a shopping cart, reflecting an institutional sales cycle instead of impulse booking.
